global.Title: AZCOT snowfall-load histograms (monthly)
global.Summary: Days per bin of the day's highest 24-hour snowfall load, and storms per bin of storm total, by month, 1991-2020 Oct-Mar (Feb 29 excluded). Snowfall load = ERA5 hourly snowfall (m water equivalent) x 204.724 lb/ft2 per m (TR-26-5 eq. 4), read in place from the SNAP ERA5 holdings. 24-hour load: trailing 24-hour sum. Storm (a definition we chose; TR-26-5 gives none, see preprocess/storm_definition/README.md): wet hours (>= 0.1 mm w.e./h) with dry gaps of at most 12 h; storm total = all snowfall from its first to its last wet hour, credited to the day it ends. Not masked: snowfall over glaciers and sea ice is real (see surface_type).
global.Encoding: {"month": {"1": "jan", "2": "feb", "3": "mar", "10": "oct", "11": "nov", "12": "dec"}, "storm_bin": "bin upper edge u: storms with previous edge < total <= u (first bin from 0; last open-ended) (lbf ft-2)"}
global.Source: AZCOT curated coverages (SNAP, UAF), preprocess/ in the AZCOT repo; ERA5 1991-2020 Oct-Mar, Feb 29 excluded
